opening.argument: The presentation ties participation to paid packages, offering five options from €100 to €5,000 and linking those packages to tokens and mining operations. It then directs participants to recruit at scale, stating, “we want you to focus on inviting lots of people, sharing it with lots of people.” The proposed business is built around automated presentations, team duplication, and multiple compensation streams, including direct sales, network, matching, startup, and leadership bonuses. Rather than neutrally explaining cryptocurrency, the speaker presents joining as access to education, tokens, and coins, alongside claims about creating wealth and appreciation. The closing instruction to “lock in your position” in a rapidly growing binary compensation plan and continue to the compensation presentation makes the solicitation to participate unmistakable.
